brief: ByteTrace：macOS 菜单栏应用级网络流量统计工具；轻量、本地记录、持续观察。生成六张独立候选，不修改现有图标。
provider: OpenAI 内置 image_gen 工具；运行时未暴露具体模型标识

variants.label: A1
variants.subject: whale with a huge rounded head-body and one short thick tail ending in two broad rounded lobes; show both lobes. Omit water, spouts and fin details. A continuous deep blue belly patch and the eyes use the same deep blue
variants.description: sky blue #3E8DDD for the main body and deep blue #163B68 for one broad belly patch and simple eyes
variants.prompt:
Create a single square image, approximately 1536 by 1536 pixels, with ordinary square outer corners.
One extremely simple, lovable baby-like whale with a huge rounded head-body and one short thick tail ending in two broad rounded lobes; show both lobes. Omit water, spouts and fin details. A continuous deep blue belly patch and the eyes use the same deep blue.
Use only sky blue #3E8DDD for the main body and deep blue #163B68 for one broad belly patch and simple eyes. These are the two character colors; reuse them for the face. The third and only other semantic color is the uniform solid muted light apricot #EBCDB6 background, visible throughout the open space.
Build the character from about four to seven large basic shapes, with one continuous chunky outer silhouette and at most two broad interior color masses. Use two simple widely spaced eyes, and no mouth unless essential. The silhouette must stay recognizable at 32 by 32 pixels.
Place the character upright, emerging from the lower-left corner and occupying about 85 to 95 percent of the square. Let the character occupy that corner, with natural cropping along the bottom or assigned side. Keep both members of any paired defining feature visible. Keep the composition off center.
Use broad rounded forms, compact proportions, soft cheeks and blunt ends. Make the treatment exceptionally clean, graphic and gentle.
Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment.
Constraints: one character only. No letters, numbers, watermark, border, frame, card, rounded-square presentation mask, scenery, props, decorative marks, outlines, thin lines, sharp points, elaborate anatomy, surface texture, photorealism, gloss, dramatic bevel, strong 3D rendering or external cast shadow. Keep the background a single uniform color without gradient, halo, vignette or lighting variation.
